jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, People
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About This Role

We’re hiring a Senior Data Analyst to support our People organization
, using data to help Fivetran attract, develop, engage, and retain exceptional talent as we scale. You’ll work across the employee lifecycle — from recruiting and workforce planning to employee experience, learning and development, performance, and retention — turning complex people data into insights that shape how we build and support our teams.

This is a high-impact, highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of data, people, and strategy
. You’ll partner closely with leaders across People, Recruiting, Finance, and the broader business to answer important organizational questions, develop scalable analytical frameworks, and improve how decisions are made.

This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA or NYC, NY office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. There is no mandate on the number of days required but we encourage employees to come in every week to collaborate.

Technologies You’ll Use

SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
dbt / dbt State
Looker / LookML
Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
Claude Code / Codex
HRIS, ATS, and other People systems and data sources

What You’ll Do

Define and own our core People metrics. Establish clear definitions and reporting across areas such as headcount, hiring, retention, organizational health, employee experience, and talent development.
Build scalable analytical products. Create canonical datasets, models, and self-service tools and dashboards that enable People teams and leaders to answer important questions quickly and consistently.
Serve as a trusted thought partner. Translate analyses into clear narratives and recommendations for audiences ranging from functional operators to senior executive leadership. Work closely with our Engineers to improve Fivetran's own HRIS and ATS connectors.
Set a high bar for responsible People Analytics. Help establish strong practices around data quality, integrity, governance, privacy, appropriate access, and the responsible use of sensitive employee data.
Turn people data into decisions. Analyze complex and disparate datasets to identify trends, surface opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to People leaders and business stakeholders.
Shape our analytics culture. Mentor other analysts and partners, establish analytical best practices, and help People teams develop stronger data fluency and decision-making habits.

Skills We’re Looking For

5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience working across large, complex datasets
Experience using Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and visualization tools
Strong analytical judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality, analytical rigor, and reproducibility
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills; you can make complex findings intuitive and help decision-makers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what to do next
Comfort operating in ambiguity, developing hypotheses, and owning analytical problems end-to-end
Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical partners
A builder mindset: you look beyond answering one-off questions and create frameworks, datasets, and tools that make future decisions faster and better
Passion for using data to improve how organizations attract, develop, and support their people
Experience using analytics to support key business decisions, preferably at a high-growth, SaaS, or B2B product company

Bonus Skills

Experience in People Analytics, workforce analytics, recruiting analytics, HR strategy, or another People-related analytical function
Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, performance management, engagement, or learning systems

jobs.description:
Job Title: Data Analyst / CDP Developer

Location: Torrance, CA

Work Model: Onsite

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

** Data Analysis and Development **

- Analyze customer data, event, and large-scale datasets to generate insights, validate data quality, and support business decision-making.
- Write, optimize, and maintain advanced SQL queries across Presto, Hive, and NoSQL systems.
- Use Python to support data processing, automation, workflow operations, and API integrations.
- Work within cloud platforms (primarily AWS) and apply general cloud data architecture principles.
- Perform exploratory data analysis to validate assumptions, identify anomalies, and support stakeholder requirements.
- Document data processes, business rules, logic, and workflows in Confluence or similar platforms.
- Collaborate with engineering, analytics, marketing, CRM teams, and SMEs to define data requirements and ensure accuracy.
- Operate CDP workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Digdag, TD Workflows) to manage pipelines and scheduled jobs.
- Enhance and monitor data quality frameworks including validation checks, alerts, and pipeline observability.
- Follow CI/CD and Git-based version control best practices for SQL, scripts, and documentation.
- Ensure adherence to privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, PII).
- Solve end-to-end data challenges—from ingestion through transformation to analysis and activation.
- Maintain rigorous attention to detail, especially with customer-level and production data.
- Proactively improve automation, data quality, workflow reliability, and system performance.
- Communicate insights and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Partner with SMEs to understand business context, refine requirements, and validate solution accuracy
** Troubleshooting & Support **
- Diagnose and resolve data pipeline failures, ingestion issues, and workflow errors in a timely manner.
- Perform root‐cause analysis using logs, pipeline metadata, and system monitoring tools.
- Support production environments by monitoring scheduled jobs, validating outputs, and ensuring data accuracy and availability.
- Implement fixes, patches, and process improvements to prevent recurring problems.
- Maintain clear documentation of issues, resolutions, and preventive actions to strengthen operational reliability.
WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BE WORKING ON

As a Data Analyst / CDP Developer, the candidate will support the customer data platform (CDP), improve data quality, implement scalable data solutions, and address end‐to‐end data challenges. This role requires advanced SQL development, CDP integration, pipeline operations, and troubleshooting across large‐scale datasets. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail‐oriented, and thrives in a fast‐paced, cross‐functional environment

WHAT’S NEEDED

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ of combined experience across data analysis, data engineering, or data operations.
- Advanced SQL and Query Optimization (Presto, Hive, NoSQL)
- Expertise in writing complex SQL queries optimizing them for large-scale datasets.
- Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDP) and CRM Systems
- Hands-on experience integrating and managing CDP solutions and CRM platforms to unify and activate customer data.
- Strong SQL expertise, including complex joins, window functions, CTEs, performance optimization.
- Proficiency with Python for data processing, automation, and APIs.
- Experience working with customer data, event data, and large-scale datasets.
- Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure (S3, IAM, data storage concepts).
- Ability to perform exploratory analysis, validate data quality, and present insights to stakeholders.
- Understanding of data modeling, schema design, identity resolution, and profile unification.
- Comfortable documenting processes, transformations, and analytical logic in Confluence or similar platforms.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work with cross-functional teams
- Hands-on experience with Treasure Data CDP or similar CDPs (Treausure Data Amperity, mParticle, Tealium etc).
- Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Digdag Workflows).
- Experience with data quality frameworks, monitoring, alerting, and pipeline observability.
- Experience with CI/CD, Git, and version control best practices.
- Understanding of privacy and compliance (GDPR, CCPA, PII handling).
- Provide support to production environment
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to deliver end-to-end solutions—from data ingestion to analysis.
- Excellent attention to detail, especially when working with customer-level and production data.
- Proactive mindset for improving data quality, automation, and system reliability.
- Ability to collaborate closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to understand domain context, validate requirements, and ensure the accuracy and alignment of data solutions.

The Project Coordinator will play a vital role in supporting the UBC Bridge to Red Seal Program, an initiative designed to assist internationally trained trades professionals in achieving recognition for their foreign credentials and obtaining Red Seal certification. The Coordinator will work closely with the Program Manager to ensure the smooth operation of daily project activities, assist with participant case management, and liaise with stakeholders. This position is ideal for a highly organized individual with a passion for supporting newcomers in the skilled trades.

Program Support and Coordination:
Assist the Program Manager in the day-to-day management and coordination of the UBC Bridge to Red Seal Program.
Help maintain project timelines and ensure that milestones are met according to the project plan.
Coordinate communication between project staff, participants, and external partners.
Any additional task as assigned by the Program manager or Director.

Participant Case Management and Support:

Help ITPs navigate provincial apprenticeship systems and secure their Prior Learning Assessment Recognition (PLAR).
Coordinate the delivery of English as an Additional Language (EAL) assessments and provide participants with access to language upgrading resources.
Assist with coordinating translation and accommodation services for participants as needed.

Data Collection and Reporting:

Assist in developing and distributing evaluation tools such as surveys to gather feedback from participants.

Training and Assessment Coordination:

Coordinate the delivery of trade-specific assessments and bridge training for participants.
Assist in the scheduling and logistics of training sessions, including securing venues and materials.
Support participants in accessing study materials, resources, and accommodations for the Red Seal exam.

Join a mission-driven team working to protect Washington’s communities by advancing cleanup of sites impacted by hazardous substances released to the environment. As a Site Manager in the Toxics Cleanup Program's southwest region, you will manage cleanup projects that enroll in the Voluntary Cleanup Program (VCP), ensuring cleanups meet the requirements of the Model Toxics Control Act (MTCA). You will evaluate complex geologic and environmental data, guide consultants and property owners toward technically sound cleanup actions, and help move contaminated sites to closure. If you are energized by applying geologic expertise to real-world cleanup projects, and want to make a direct and positive impact across the region, we would be thrilled to welcome your talent to our team.

What You Will Do

Review and evaluate technical reports, sampling data, work plans, scopes of work, and corrective-action proposals to identify regulatory compliance, data adequacy, and next steps for contaminated sites.
Conduct and document initial investigations and site hazard assessments, including data analysis, contamination evaluation, and preparation of clear written recommendations and assessment reports.
Provide technical oversight and geologic/hydrogeologic review of complex cleanup sites, including evaluating field activities, monitoring-well installation, and environmental sampling plans.
Prepare technical correspondence, opinion letters, regulatory determinations, and other cleanup documentation that clearly communicates requirements and supports cleanup progress.
Collaborate with property owners, consultants, community members, and local or state agencies to address technical issues, communicate expectations, and support productive, solution-focused interactions.
Offer technical assistance and mentorship to junior staff, contribute to peer reviews, and participate in program workgroups, planning efforts, and policy review as needed.
Maintain accurate site records and ensure timely data submittals and document uploads in agency databases to support tracking, reporting, and regulatory decision-making.

Possession

About Us

At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real-world impact.

“For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive.

When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact.

Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way.

LOCAL TO DENVER with travel.

Due to client contractual obligations, this position does require a drug test - including marijuana.

A Day in the Life

A Junior Environmental Scientist
participates as a member of an emergency response team to conduct environmental sampling and data collection. In performing such duties, a Junior Environmental Scientist will conduct research or perform investigations for the purpose of identifying, abating, or eliminating sources of pollutants or hazards that affect either the environment or the health of the population. Utilizing their knowledge of various scientific disciplines, they may collect, synthesize, study, report, and act based on data derived from measurements or observations of air, food, soil, water, and other sources. The successful candidate will apply scientific methodology for analysis of risk assessments and industrial hygiene applications to ensure the client’s expectations are met. All Junior Environmental Scientist’s shall maintain a response bag with company issued PPE and appropriate work clothing. This role is also subject to on-call rotation for emergency response and frequent, extended travel. The on-call rotation duties may extend to satellite offices as necessary. Travel on a moment’s notice may extend further than just the on-call rotation i.e. in the event a response requires more staffing support.

The compensation range for this role is $38,500 to $52,000
commensurate with experience, skills, and geographic location.

To thrive in this role, you’ll be comfortable taking ownership of the following responsibilities:

Immediate availability for extended travel and emergency response at client’s request
Maintain, calibrate and mobilize equipment appropriate for an emergency response
Gather and analyze samples from various sources of potential contamination
Perform monitoring and sampling activities according to the prescribed methods
Compile, review and summarize scientific/technical data and literature; and,
Completion of 40-hour HAZWOPER training in accordance with 29 CFR 1910.120 within first three weeks of hire date
Possession of DISA & TWIC clearances within 3 months of hire date
Completion of all designated safety requirements within first month of hire date; and
Perform other duties as assigned

Your Expertise And Skills

Bachelor's degree in Biology, Environmental Engineering, Environmental, Health and Safety,
Industrial Hygiene, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Toxicology or other related science
1 to 3 years of experience in a related field may be substituted in lieu of a degree
Advanced computer skills in a Windows-based platform is a must

Ability to work independently and with minimal supervision
Ability to respond in a timely manner to all communications from his/her supervisor
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships within a matrix reporting structure
Ability to understand and follow written and verbal directions
Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
Ability to complete HAZWOPER certification
Ability to obtain and maintain DISA clearance
Ability to obtain TWIC clearance
Current driver’s license
Ability to obtain a passport
Completion of all job specific OSHA training
Ability to comply with all job specific OSHA requirements, including the wear of a respirator
Possess excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with careful attention to detail being critical
Possess a high degree of personal initiative and responsibility for work assigned
Ability to understand and follow written and verbal directions
Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in the English language; and,
Ability to work overtime and on weekends

We may provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, consistent with applicable law, to support performance of the essential functions.

Sitting, standing, and walking
Lifting up to 50 pounds several times a day
Overhead lifting of over 20 pounds
Bending, stooping, climbing ladders and crawling
Long hours involving overtime and weekends as necessary
Keyboarding/typing

Works in an office environment when not deployed on an emergency response

Comfort navigating cross-functional relationships between technical, administrative, and financial teams.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve non-standard challenges using sound judgment.

Ability to work independently with minimal direction and to prioritize tasks based on changing project needs.
Experience managing documentation associated with subconsultants, contracts, and permits.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive materials appropriately.
Track record of contributing to successful team coordination on medium to large-scale projects.
Ability to lead documentation audits or coordinate data gathering during internal or external reviews.
Willingness to support the development of junior staff in coordination-related tasks.
Demonstrated reliability, initiative, and accountability in supporting project teams.
Ability to meet attendance schedule with dependability and consistency.

Associate's Degree.
Experience supporting multi-office or multidisciplinary project teams within a consulting engineering firm.
Familiarity with Primavera, Oracle, or Deltek systems.

At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real-world impact.

“For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive.

When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact.

Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way.

LOCAL TO DENVER with travel.

Due to client contractual obligations, this position does require a drug test - including marijuana.

A Day in the Life

A Junior Environmental Scientist
participates as a member of an emergency response team to conduct environmental sampling and data collection. In performing such duties, a Junior Environmental Scientist will conduct research or perform investigations for the purpose of identifying, abating, or eliminating sources of pollutants or hazards that affect either the environment or the health of the population. Utilizing their knowledge of various scientific disciplines, they may collect, synthesize, study, report, and act based on data derived from measurements or observations of air, food, soil, water, and other sources. The successful candidate will apply scientific methodology for analysis of risk assessments and industrial hygiene applications to ensure the client’s expectations are met. All Junior Environmental Scientist’s shall maintain a response bag with company issued PPE and appropriate work clothing. This role is also subject to on-call rotation for emergency response and frequent, extended travel. The on-call rotation duties may extend to satellite offices as necessary. Travel on a moment’s notice may extend further than just the on-call rotation i.e. in the event a response requires more staffing support.

The compensation range for this role is $38,500 to $52,000
commensurate with experience, skills, and geographic location.

Immediate availability for extended travel and emergency response at client’s request
Maintain, calibrate and mobilize equipment appropriate for an emergency response
Gather and analyze samples from various sources of potential contamination
Perform monitoring and sampling activities according to the prescribed methods
Compile, review and summarize scientific/technical data and literature; and,
Completion of 40-hour HAZWOPER training in accordance with 29 CFR 1910.120 within first three weeks of hire date
Possession of DISA & TWIC clearances within 3 months of hire date
Completion of all designated safety requirements within first month of hire date; and
Perform other duties as assigned

Bachelor's degree in Biology, Environmental Engineering, Environmental, Health and Safety,
Industrial Hygiene, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Toxicology or other related science

Ability to work independently and with minimal supervision
Ability to respond in a timely manner to all communications from his/her supervisor
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships within a matrix reporting structure
Ability to understand and follow written and verbal directions
Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
Ability to complete HAZWOPER certification
Ability to obtain and maintain DISA clearance
Ability to obtain TWIC clearance
Current driver’s license
Ability to obtain a passport
Completion of all job specific OSHA training
Ability to comply with all job specific OSHA requirements, including the wear of a respirator
Possess excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with careful attention to detail being critical
Possess a high degree of personal initiative and responsibility for work assigned
Ability to understand and follow written and verbal directions
Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in the English language; and,
Ability to work overtime and on weekends

Sitting, standing, and walking

Overhead lifting of over 20 pounds
Bending, stooping, climbing ladders and crawling

Keyboarding/typing

Works in an office environment when not deployed on an emergency response
Often works outdoors and may be exposed to hot and cold environments and extreme weather conditions, including sunlit, rainy and windy conditions

Nevada Gold Mines is seeking an mid-career Mine Geologist to join the team at our Underground operations. This is an exciting opportunity to work hands-on in an active underground mine, where you’ll play a key role in understanding and guiding one of Nevada’s premier gold deposits.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Operations, Engineering, and Ore Control teams to collect high-quality geological data that supports safe, efficient mining. From underground mapping and sampling to data analysis, modeling, and reconciliation, you’ll gain exposure to the full mine-to-model workflow while developing your technical and professional skills. Safety, teamwork, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do, and you’ll be empowered to make a real impact from day one.

Drive zero harm workplace through the responsibility to stop unsafe work and other company safety programs, while promoting a positive work environment.

The FRM Data Analyst will aggregate and analyze data from multiple sources and platforms to evaluate FRM activity, operational performance, key performance indicators (KPIs), program metrics, reimbursement trends, and overall FRM impact.

A primary responsibility of this position is ownership and support of reporting for Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), executive/client presentations, recurring program reporting, and ad hoc business requests.

Evaluate relationships between FRM activities and measurable program outcomes to help demonstrate FRM impact and value.
Identify trends, opportunities, performance gaps, emerging reimbursement barriers, and areas requiring additional investigation.
Develop benchmarking and trending analyses across programs when appropriate.
Support leadership in evaluating individual, regional, team, and program-level performance.

MBR & QBR Reporting

Partner with FRM leadership and Client Services to develop clear reporting narratives around program performance.

Cross-Functional Data Management

Collaborate with stakeholders across multiple client programs to understand reporting requirements and business objectives.

Work with data originating from platforms such as CRM systems, Salesforce, Veeva, Power BI, FRM portals, HUB platforms, client systems, Excel-based trackers, and other reporting environments.

Conduct targeted analyses to answer operational and strategic business questions.
Provide rapid analysis when leadership needs visibility into emerging client concerns, reimbursement trends, access barriers, team activity, or operational performance.

About This Opportunity

The Project Coordinator – Capital Markets will drive key operational initiatives, bridge tech and secondary marketing workflows, and manage end-to-end process development from inception to execution. This role demands exceptional attention to detail and rigorous, proactive follow-up with cross-functional teams to keep projects on track and eliminate roadblocks. You will lead capital markets project testing, make informed execution decisions, maintain seamless alignment across departments to ensure closed-loop communication.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Process Development
Work with leadership to identify areas for improvement with the department workflow and current process and coordinate update from start to finish.
Maintain up-to-date, step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and training materials for operational teams.
Identify workflow bottlenecks and build structured rollout plans for new operational procedures.
Cross-Functional Follow-Up & Alignment
Maintain continuous follow-up with other departments to ensure project deliverables stay on schedule.
Serve as the central hub for open project items, tracking dependencies, action items, and timelines with high precision.
Lead project status meetings, document clear meeting notes, and communicate updates effectively across all stakeholder levels.
IT Project Testing & QA
Develop detailed user acceptance testing (UAT) scripts for pricing engines, loan origination systems (LOS), and secondary marketing platforms.
Execute rigorous end-to-end testing with meticulous attention to edge cases, logging bugs accurately and verifying fixes before release.
Coordinate integration testing between internal mortgage technology tools and external investor portals.  
Operational Decision-Making
Evaluate project risks, scope shifts, and timeline impacts to make confident, well-reasoned operational decisions.
Prioritize technical feature requests and bug fixes based on revenue impact, risk exposure, and team efficiency.

Location and Schedule

This is a full-time, office-based position in a modern, cozy environment in our Troy, MI office.
Our standard working hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

Skills & Qualifications

Experience: 3+ years of project coordination experience; mortgage industry background required (Secondary Marketing/Capital Markets preferred).
Core Competencies: Meticulous attention to detail, proactive multi-team follow-up, UAT testing, process mapping, and operational decision-making
Cross-Functional Communication: Ability to translate complex capital markets concepts and technical IT requirements into clear, actionable language in order to ensure project success. Ability to hold other teams accountable to deadlines.
Executive & Stakeholder Reporting: Strong verbal and written skills for delivering concise project status reports, risk assessments, decision summaries, and meeting briefings to senior managers.

Company Culture: Inclusive, supportive company culture where you are not a number, but a voice that's heard and brings value.
Growth Path: Defined paid training and clear pathways for career development.
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package including PTO, sick days, paid volunteer hours, medical, dental, vision insurance, and 401(k).
